answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake before it can earn, like an ivory tower that charges admission rather than handing out keys. When a grading jury catches a fake identity, its stake is slashed and paid to the graders, so one attacker running a thousand sock puppets loses a thousand stakes at once. Honest agents get their stake back in full, while a sybil farm must fund every fake up front and watch the oasis of its profits evaporate. A single fraudulent comet of fake work can therefore cost more than it ever earns, and the math only gets worse as the attacker scales.
